title: VantageEdge Co-sell Risk Scouting & Pipeline Triage Huddle
summary: Weekly partner pipeline triage focused on three high-risk co-sell opportunities, alignment on next-week joint outreach, and clarifying security gating for private deployment use cases. Agreed to run a quick POC benchmark for Deal B and share updated co-sell tracker.
topics: Co-sell revenue split and referral motion
action_items: Ethan Morales - Share updated co-sell tracker (with deal health notes) - 2026-01-12
Sofia Zhang - Run 1-hr POC bench for Deal B (10k token doc gen workload) and provide latency/cost sketch - 2026-01-15
Priya Rao (VantageEdge) - Confirm final list of stakeholders for Deal A exec intro - 2026-01-11
Lina Gomez (VantageEdge) - Send SOC2/ISO attestation questions to Caroline - 2026-01-13
Caroline Ruiz - Draft joint outreach email templates for Deal C to be approved by both parties - 2026-01-14
next_steps: Ethan to update shared spreadsheet and tag owners
Schedule 30m benchmark review with Deal B stakeholders
Exchange security questionnaire answers via secure folder
Prep exec intro cadence for Deal A (target week of Jan 19)
transcript:
Meeting header:
Date: 2026-01-09
Time: 15:30 UTC
Duration: ~61 minutes
Recording: yes
Notes: quick triage, partner-led pipeline review

00:00 Ethan Morales: Hey everyone, thanks for making time, appreciate it. quick agenda — three deals, risk flags, ownership. Sofia you good to jump in on the technical openers later?
00:18 Martin Kline: Yep yep, Martin here — gonna run through Deal A and C and then Samir will do the deal B highlight. real quick, are we on the right tracker? I saw two copies.
00:32 Ethan Morales: Good call, there was an older copy, I just pushed the canonical tracker to the shared drive. link's in the chat — "VE-Redwood-CoSell-Tracker-2026-01-09". please reference that one. sorry about duplication.
00:48 Priya Rao: Perfect. high level on prioritization — Deal A is our biggest ARR but long procurement cycle; Deal B is fast but has security gating for private deploy; Deal C is puddle size but likely to close quickly if we help with pricing.
01:05 Sofia Zhang: quick tech note — Deal B's ask for on-prem is kinda heavy: they want HSM-backed keys and an air-gapped option possibly. we can do Private with KMS integration but air-gap is a different beast.
01:20 Lina Gomez: yes from compliance side that is the big hold-up, we need details: where logs live, can we retain full audit trails, and contractually required retention windows.
01:35 Caroline Ruiz: we'll put SOC2 + ISO docs in the secure folder. Ethan, i sent a short checklist earlier, Lina can you confirm what else we need?
01:48 Lina Gomez: a sample audit log would be great, and encryption at rest proof — sometimes the vendor docs are light.
02:03 Samir Patel: jumping into Deal B — this is a mid-size financial services prospect, current model is slow with their own infra and they love the accuracy, they just need latency and data residency assurance. they're price sensitive though.
02:18 Ethan Morales: ok so for Deal B we propose a short POC: 1) small private deployment in our shared VPC with sample datasets 2) run a gen workload to show 95th percentile latency and token cost 3) provide security docs and KMS integration notes. Sofia can you scope the bench?
02:33 Sofia Zhang: yes I can scope it. quick caveat — running the bench in a shared VPC vs full on-prem will surface a subset of the performance risk. for full on-prem we need a different checklist and timeline.
02:50 Martin Kline: who will own outreach to the buyer? i can loop them but we prefer joint AC (account contact) intro.
03:03 Ethan Morales: Samir and Martin co-own outreach, we'll provide the deck and a tech short. Samir will do day-to-day with buyer, Martin does exec intro. I'll draft the template after this call.
03:20 Samir Patel: agreed.
03:28 Ethan Morales: quick status check on Deal A — large healthcare customer, multi-cloud requirement, red flag is a procurement timeline and the need for private deployment in EU region with SAR/DSAR concerns. Priya?
03:42 Priya Rao: that's right — they asked for data residency proof and local logging, plus an indemnity clause tweak. procurement is slow. our playbook is exec-level intro then shared legal call. who from Redwood legal should be on that?
03:56 Caroline Ruiz: i will coordinate, probably need someone from sales-legal; i'll check availability.
04:10 Martin Kline: can Redwood offer a limited data residency commitment while we negotiate SOW? 
04:22 Ethan Morales: we can offer region pinning for Hosted models and Dedicated pools for stronger isolation. Private on-prem gets closer to their ask but increases cost. we'll map options in the tracker.
04:35 Lina Gomez: what about key management — who controls keys in the dedicated pool?
04:40 Sofia Zhang: we support customer-managed KMS for Dedicated and Private. for hosted, we can provide an HSM-backed KMS but customers often want dedicated control for compliance.
04:54 Martin Kline: ok sounds good.
05:05 Ethan Morales: switching to Deal C — small proof of concept with 3-week timeline, close if pricing acceptable. primary ask is a partner discount structure and referral revenue split. Priya any guidance on split?
05:20 Priya Rao: typical is 70/30 for newer deals, but for strategic accounts we sometimes do 60/40. depends on who brings the buyer and who leads the exec conversations.
05:33 Samir Patel: we probably should hold a pricing call with finance; I'll coordinate internally.
05:45 Ethan Morales: noted.
05:53 [00:06:00 marker — housekeeping, someone shares deck link]
06:00 Caroline Ruiz: i dropped the joint GTM deck and the co-sell checklist in the folder: drive.redwood/vantageedge/gtd-deck-Jan2026.
06:10 Priya Rao: got it. quick Q about contract — do we have a standard referral terms template?
06:18 Ethan Morales: yes will attach referral template to tracker.
06:22 [06:30 Sofia starts screen share to show tracker briefly — audio distortion for a few seconds]
06:40 Sofia Zhang: ok see tracker row for Deal B — I'll add bench steps under technical notes. i'm marking risk = "security_gate" right now.
06:52 Martin Kline: what's the expected timeline for bench? we need to tell the buyer.
07:00 Sofia Zhang: i can run bench next week — estimate 48 hours to execute and then 30–60m to consolidate results. we need their sample dataset and answer to a quick infra questionnaire.
07:16 Samir Patel: i'll pull the sample dataset this afternoon.
07:23 Ethan Morales: great, add that to action items.
07:30 Priya Rao: on Deal A can we do an exec briefing the week of Jan 19? procurement's expected window shrinks if execs are convinced.
07:45 Ethan Morales: yes, target week of Jan 19 works. Martin will make the intro. Caroline will prep legal call.
07:55 Lina Gomez: small note, vendor attestation forms sometimes ask for retention of PII — need explicit answers on that.
08:06 Sofia Zhang: we will confirm retention policies. also note, caching/KV cache behavior when deployed in Private can change token cost slightly — i want to be transparent about that.
08:22 Martin Kline: that may affect pricing. we should present cost scenarios.
08:28 Ethan Morales: i'll make a cost sketch for each deployment option in the tracker.
08:34 [08:40 Samir accidentally interrupts]
08:40 Samir Patel: sorry, quick — we've had buyer ask about fallback behavior if our region is full — do you have automatic fallback to another model/region?
08:52 Sofia Zhang: yes we have smart routing, but for private or dedicated there are stricter rules. for hosted we can fallback to a smaller variant to preserve latency SLAs. i'll add notes.
09:05 Ethan Morales: good.
09:10 [09:30 marker — mid-call quick recap]
09:30 Ethan Morales: recap so far — Deal B: bench next week (Sofia), Samir to provide dataset, Lina to send compliance questions, Deal A: plan exec intro week of Jan 19, Deal C: pricing call. agreed?
09:42 Martin Kline: agreed.
09:46 Priya Rao: agreed.
09:50 [10:15 Sofia shares preliminary bench config — some terminology mis-transcribed: "quantization-friendly execution path" -> "quantization friendly exertion path" in auto-text]
10:20 Sofia Zhang: the bench config is 4 GPUs, sequence length 2k for realistic docs, using mixed precision; will run continuous batching scenario to approximate production latency.
10:35 Lina Gomez: can we get a statement on logging retention for the bench? they want 90 days.
10:45 Sofia Zhang: bench logs are ephemeral but we can export a sample for audit. production retention will be configurable per contract.
10:56 Samir Patel: the buyer also wants to know if there's a direct SLA for tokens and throughput.
11:05 Ethan Morales: we offer SLA for Dedicated and have SLOs for hosted; Dedicated has stricter uptime. i'll mark that in the tracker.
11:18 [11:40 slight crosstalk when someone joins late]
11:45 Guest (unlabeled): sorry I'm late — i'm Joe from Sales Ops.
11:50 Joe R.: just to note, Deal B's forecast in our CRM is a green but that's on optimistic pipeline; we should be conservative.
12:04 Ethan Morales: thanks Joe, good call. i will lower the internal confidence level and we'll update forecast after bench results.
12:14 Priya Rao: legal ask on Deal A — an indemnity carve-out; our standard client can't accept broad indemnity. we need to coordinate legal.
12:26 Caroline Ruiz: i'll open a legal thread and propose a narrow change; will loop Redwood legal.
12:36 Sofia Zhang: on a technical blocker — if buyer needs complete air-gapped deployment we need to size timeline at 6–8 weeks beyond standard private. i want to manage expectations.
12:51 Martin Kline: that is a deal-killer for them if procurement is deadline-driven. any lighter-weight alternative?
13:02 Sofia Zhang: hybrid approach: dedicated pool in a nearby region with customer-managed KMS may be acceptable for now, we should validate with their security team.
13:15 Priya Rao: let's propose that as interim.
13:22 Ethan Morales: good.
13:30 [14:00 marker — approaching close, time check]
14:00 Ethan Morales: last bits — competitor check. Martin noted DeepServe is doing a lowball price play; we need to emphasize performance and reliability. thoughts?
14:16 Martin Kline: DeepServe is discounting heavily, but our partner GTM on-prem+security positions differently. highlight that.
14:26 Caroline Ruiz: also amplify joint references — i can surface a case study.
14:33 Priya Rao: please do, decision makers respond to peer examples.
14:40 Ethan Morales: ok next steps again: Sofia runs bench, Samir gets dataset, Lina & Caroline handle security paperwork, Ethan updates tracker and shares outreach templates.
14:56 Samir Patel: i'll schedule the buyer call after bench results, should be quick.
15:05 Joe R.: ops note — i updated CRM with today's notes, deal ids match CRM-VE-7892/VE-7893/VE-7894.
15:18 Ethan Morales: perfect. last thing — we'll reconvene if bench uncovers major risks; otherwise short 20m sync next Monday to close loop. thanks everyone.
15:30 [meeting ends]
